item.title: Games with loot boxes to get minimum 16 age rating across Europe
item.description:
📝 Currently the new ratings will only apply to games released after June. Games with "play-by-appointment" style mechanisms such as daily quests will get a PEGI 7 rating - but if the mechanisms "punish players for not returning", such by losing content, they will become PEGI 12. Games lacking any way for users to report or block players online will receive a PEGI 18 rating.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cge84xqjg5lo
